summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Verizon Communications Inc. on May 14, 2026, noting the listing of numerous debt securities and common stock on exchanges. The filing contains no special situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is a current report under Items 8.01 and 9.01, listing securities registered under Section 12(b) of the Exchange Act. No actionable special situation is present.
